description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchHooks class, which manages logic hooks for synchronizing the Elasticsearch index with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans. It includes methods for handling save and delete events, reindexing beans, and error handling.

classes.name: ElasticSearchHooks
classes.description: Handles logic hooks to keep the Elasticsearch index synchronized with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans, including save and delete callbacks, reindexing, and error handling.

methods.name: beanSaved
methods.description: Callback method triggered when a bean is saved; sets action to 'index' and reindexes if enabled.

methods.name: beanDeleted
methods.description: Callback method triggered when a bean is deleted; sets action to 'remove' and reindexes if enabled.

methods.name: reIndexSafe
methods.description: Attempts to reindex a bean, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: reIndex
methods.description: Performs the reindexing or removal of a bean in Elasticsearch, checking if the indexer is enabled and if the bean's module is blacklisted.

methods.name: getIndexer
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the ElasticSearchIndexer instance for the current bean.

methods.name: isBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if the bean's module is blacklisted from indexing.

methods.name: correctAction
methods.description: Adjusts the action to 'remove' if the bean is marked as deleted.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes the indexing or removal of the bean based on the current action.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during reindexing, using the indexer's logger if available, otherwise a new SuiteLogger.
